::: {#def-odds-ratio}
#### Odds ratio

Let:

- $\odds_1$ be the [odds](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-odds) of a [binary](data.qmd#def-binary-var) outcome in group 1.
- $\odds_2$ be the odds of the same outcome in the [reference group](#def-reference-group), group 2.

The **odds ratio** of group 1 compared with group 2 is

$$\ror \eqdef \frac{\odds_1}{\odds_2} \in (0, \infty).$$

Here $\odds_g = \risk_g / (1 - \risk_g)$ for the [risk](#def-outcome-risk) $\risk_g$ of group $g$.

Source: @wikipedia_odds_ratio.
:::
